# CPH2653_16.0.10.501(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: OTA descriptionInfo
> OTA 指纹: `CPH2653_11.F.93_2930_202608071055 `

## Home screen & Lock screen
- You can now use a 2-finger spread gesture on the Home screen to clear all app notification badges.

## System tools
- You can now annotate images directly in Notes to highlight key points.

## Camera & Photos
- Introducing AI Remix Collage, which lets you extract subjects from videos, save them as animated stickers, and apply them to videos, motion photos, or other still photos to create new motion photos or add animated outlines for more creative designs.
- Fixes an issue where some icons, text, and menus might remain in portrait mode when using Camera in landscape mode.

## Security & privacy
- Improves virus protection by automatically blocking high-risk behaviors, such as the abuse of Accessibility services, keeping a record of detected events, and providing alerts to help protect your data. You can find this feature in "Phone Manager - Viruses & risks - Block suspicious app activities".
- Improves the experience of using hidden apps. While using a hidden app, you can swipe up from the bottom of the screen toward the floating window area in the upper-right corner to open it in a floating window.
- Integrates the August 2026 Android security patch to enhance system security.

# CPH2653_16.0.9.402(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: OTA descriptionInfo
> OTA 指纹: `CPH2653_11.F.92_2920_202607071721 `

## Home screen & Lock screen
- A wider selection of custom fingerprint icons and animations is now available. You can find this feature in "Settings - Home screen, Lock screen & style - More - Fingerprint animation".
- Improves transition animations when opening and switching apps in "Recent Tasks," resulting in a faster, more fluid multitasking experience.

## Camera & Photos
- Introduces the "Primrose" filter, delivering gentle, warm skin tones in portraits while naturally creating a nostalgic film-inspired look.
- Introduces the "Bold B&W" filter, crafted especially for documentary photography. Its dramatic interplay of light and shadow delivers a striking visual impression.

## Device Connect
- You can now lock your PC remotely with a single tap. After your phone connects to your PC remotely, you can unlock your PC directly from the phone without entering your PC's password.

## Security & privacy
- You can now add a backup face for device unlocking, so you can access your device even if you're wearing glasses or makeup. You can find this feature in "Settings - Security & privacy - Device unlock - Face & fingerprint unlock - Face - Add backup face".
- Integrates the July 2026 Android security patch to enhance system security.
